info.name: 🤖 Autonomous Research Agent
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Autonomous Research Agent.

## How to use:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set the `base_url` variable to `http://localhost:8000`
3. Use **Step 1** → Submit a research query
4. Copy the `job_id` from the response
5. Use **Step 2** → Poll status with that `job_id`
6. Use **Step 3** → Download final report

## Architecture:
- POST /api/v1/research → Starts async research (returns immediately)
- GET  /api/v1/research/{job_id} → Poll progress & results
- GET  /api/v1/research/{job_id}/report → Get final Markdown report
- GET  /api/v1/jobs → List all past jobs
- GET  /api/v1/health → Server health check

variable.description: Base URL of the running server. Change port if needed.
Job ID returned from POST /api/v1/research. Update this after submitting a job.

request.description:
## Health Check

Verifies that the server is running and the SQLite database is reachable.

### Response Fields:
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `status` | Always `ok` if server is up |
| `database` | `connected` or `disconnected` |
| `default_provider` | LLM provider configured in .env (`groq` or `gemini`) |
| `timestamp` | Current server UTC time |

### Use this to:
- Confirm the server started correctly
- Check database connectivity
- Verify which LLM provider is active

## Submit Research Query (Async)

Submits a research topic to the agent. Returns immediately (202 Accepted) and runs in the background.

### Request Body:
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | Yes | Research question (3-500 chars) |
| `provider` | string | No | `groq` or `gemini` (overrides .env) |
| `max_iterations` | int | No | Max ReAct loop steps (1-50, default: 10) |

### Response (202 Accepted):
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `job_id` | UUID — use this for all follow-up requests |
| `query` | Echoed back research question |
| `status` | Always `running` at this point |
| `message` | Confirmation message |
| `created_at` | Timestamp of job creation |

NOTE: The test script auto-saves `job_id` to the collection variable.

item.name: 📊 Step 2 — Poll Job Status and Results

request.description:
## Poll Research Job Status and Results

Keep calling this endpoint until `success` is `true` or `false`.

### Response Fields:
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `job_id` | The job UUID |
| `query` | Original research question |
| `success` | `null` = still running, `true` = done, `false` = failed |
| `steps` | Array of ReAct loop steps (Thought, Action, Observation) |
| `notes` | Factual notes extracted from web pages with source URLs |
| `visited_urls` | All web pages the agent scraped |
| `final_summary` | Full synthesized Markdown report (populated when done) |
| `total_tokens` | Token usage count |
| `total_latency_ms` | Total LLM API latency in milliseconds |

### When to stop polling:
- `success = true` — Research complete, report ready
- `success = false` — Research failed

### Errors:
- `404 Not Found` — Invalid or wrong `job_id`

request.description:
## Export Synthesized Markdown Report

Returns the full research report as raw Markdown text.

### Report Structure:
```
# Research Report: [Your Query]

## Executive Summary
...

## Key Findings
- Finding 1 [1]
- Finding 2 [2]

## Detailed Analysis
...

## Sources and References
[1] https://source-url-1.com
[2] https://source-url-2.com
```

### Use this to:
- Copy the final polished report
- Save it as a `.md` file
- Feed it into a document or CMS

### Note:
- Only meaningful after job `success = true`

query.description: Max number of jobs to return (1-100, default: 20)

request.description:
## List Recent Research Jobs

Returns a paginated history of all submitted research jobs.

### Query Parameters:
| Param | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | 20 | Number of jobs to return (max 100) |
| `offset` | 0 | Skip N jobs (for pagination) |

### Response Fields:
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `total` | Number of jobs returned in this batch |
| `jobs` | Array of job summaries |
| `jobs[].job_id` | UUID of the job |
| `jobs[].query` | Research question |
| `jobs[].success` | `true` = done, `false` = failed |
| `jobs[].total_tokens` | Tokens consumed |
| `jobs[].total_latency_ms` | Total LLM latency |
| `jobs[].created_at` | ISO timestamp |

### Use this to:
- Review all past research queries
- Find old job IDs
- Monitor system usage
